title: Brand Manager
jobDescription:
Must-have Experience: 3–5 years in Brand Management / Advertising

Role Summary
We are looking for a passionate and strategic Brand Manager to lead the brand narrative for our residential projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and executing high-impact brand campaigns, shaping consumer perception, and driving brand salience across traditional and digital channels. This is a high-ownership role requiring creative thinking, market understanding, and sharp execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement end-to-end brand campaigns for project launches and brand-building initiatives.
  • Translate project briefs into strong creative routes and supervise agency execution across Print, TV, OOH, Digital, Radio, and BTL.
  • Build differentiated brand positioning in new markets (e.g., Hyderabad, Pune Dubai).
  • Lead ATL & BTL media planning in collaboration with internal teams and media agencies.
  • Work with in-house creative teams and external partners to ensure high-impact creatives and timely rollouts.
  • Own brand messaging, tonality, and consistency across platforms and touchpoints.
  • Track campaign performance, analyze insights, and optimize for impact and ROI.
  • Develop region-specific brand communication keeping in mind local nuances and consumer behavior.
  • Work with cross-functional teams (Sales, Digital, Research, Product) for cohesive execution.


Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong storytelling and communication skills.
  • Experience in handling creative agencies and media planning.
  • Deep understanding of consumer insights and market dynamics.
  • Ability to convert business briefs into strong creative communication.
  • High sense of aesthetics, attention to detail, and passion for branding.
  • Comfort with fast-paced, high-pressure environments and multiple deadlines.

title: PRELA1
jobDescription:
Company: Casagrand Premier Builder Limited
Department: Projects / Business Development / Land & Approvals
Location: Chennai / Bengaluru / Hyderabad

Job Summary

The Pre-Launch Executive is responsible for coordinating all activities required before the official launch of a residential project. The role involves liaising with internal departments and external consultants to ensure statutory approvals, project documentation, design readiness, sales enablement, and marketing deliverables are completed within the planned timelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate pre-launch activities across Land Acquisition, Approvals, Architecture, Projects, Legal, Marketing, and Sales teams.
  • Track project approvals, statutory clearances, and documentation required before launch.
  • Ensure architectural drawings, master plans, unit plans, and project specifications are finalized.
  • Coordinate with consultants, architects, and government authorities for timely approvals.
  • Prepare project launch checklists and monitor milestone completion.
  • Coordinate preparation of brochures, pricing sheets, inventory, sales kits, and marketing collateral.
  • Support CRM and Sales teams with project information and launch readiness.
  • Prepare MIS reports and provide regular status updates to management.
  • Ensure all pre-launch activities are completed within the scheduled timeline.

Desired Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Planning, or MBA.
  • 2–6 years of experience in Real Estate Project Coordination, Pre-Launch, Approvals, or Project Management.
  • Good understanding of CMDA/DTCP/RERA approvals and residential project lifecycle.
  • Strong coordination, planning, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficient in MS Excel, PowerPoint, AutoCAD (preferred), and project tracking tools.

Key Skills

  • Project Coordination
  • Pre-Launch Planning
  • Regulatory Approvals
  • Cross-functional Coordination
  • MIS Reporting
  • Project Documentation
  • Timeline Management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Real Estate Operations
  • Communication & Follow-up

title: Aggregation1
jobDescription:
Land Aggregation Executive

Company: Casagrand Premier Builder Limited
Department: Land Acquisition (Aggregation)
Location: Chennai
Experience: 2–6 Years

Job Summary

The Land Aggregation Executive is responsible for identifying and aggregating land parcels for residential and mixed-use developments. The role involves sourcing potential land opportunities, coordinating with landowners, brokers, and consultants, conducting preliminary due diligence, and supporting land acquisition activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and evaluate land parcels based on business requirements.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with landowners, brokers, and channel partners.
  • Conduct preliminary land feasibility assessments, including location, access, zoning, and development potential.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Technical, Finance, and Approvals teams for due diligence and documentation.
  • Collect and verify land-related documents, including title deeds, Patta, Chitta, FMB sketches, EC, and survey records.
  • Support commercial negotiations and facilitate land acquisition transactions.
  • Monitor market trends and maintain a database of prospective land parcels.
  • Prepare MIS reports and provide regular updates on acquisition opportunities.

Desired Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline
  • 2–6 years of experience in land aggregation, land acquisition, or real estate business development.
  • Good understanding of land records, title verification, statutory approvals, and the real estate development process.
  • Strong negotiation, networking, and stakeholder management skills.

Key Skills

  • Land Aggregation
  • Land Acquisition
  • Land Sourcing
  • Real Estate
  • Due Diligence
  • Title Verification
  • Patta, Chitta & FMB
  • Encumbrance Certificate (EC)
  • Survey Coordination
  • Broker Management
  • Negotiation
  • Stakeholder Management
  • MIS Reporting
  • Market Intelligence

title: Pre Legal 1
jobDescription:
About Casagrand Builders

Casagrand Builders is one of South India's leading real estate developers, delivering premium residential communities through innovation, quality, and customer-centricity. We are looking for an experienced Pre Legal Executive to strengthen our Legal team and support land acquisition and project development activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive legal due diligence for land acquisition and project development.
  • Verify and scrutinize title documents, parent deeds, sale deeds, partition deeds, settlement deeds, gift deeds, and release deeds.
  • Examine revenue records including Patta, Chitta, Adangal, FMB Sketch, Town Survey Land Register (TSLR), and Encumbrance Certificates (EC).
  • Identify title defects, legal risks, encumbrances, and litigation issues, and prepare detailed due diligence reports.
  • Coordinate with advocates, landowners, registration offices, survey teams, and government authorities for document verification and legal compliance.
  • Support the legal team during land acquisition, approvals, and project launches.
  • Maintain and update legal records, property documents, and due diligence trackers.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable property laws, registration procedures, and local regulations.

Desired Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor's Degree in Law (LLB) is preferred.
  • 3–7 years of experience in pre-legal activities within the real estate, construction, or property development industry.
  • Strong knowledge of land acquisition processes, title verification, and property documentation.
  • Familiarity with registration procedures, revenue records, and statutory approvals.
  • Excellent analytical, documentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating with cross-functional teams.
